# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Report it privately. Open the repository's **Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability**. Never open a public issue for it.

## Scope

Report here a flaw in this repository's own code: the port, the `pstack` command, the installer, and the workflows.

The skill text comes from [cursor/plugins](https://github.com/cursor/plugins). If the flaw is in the text of an upstream skill, it belongs to that repository too. Say so in your report, so we can tell upstream.

## Supported versions

Only the newest release gets fixes. `pstack update` moves an install to it.
